title: Scribe Journal Entry
description: Schema for Scribe session journal entries. Additive-only: new fields may be added, existing fields are never removed or renamed.

user_id.description: Owner identifier — links entries to the user who created them. Optional at the writer door: defaults to the config.json owner.

project.description: Which project this entry belongs to — validated against canonical/projects.json (or the user's config), not a hardcoded enum

type.description: Category of journal entry. Core types listed; users may extend via core/taxonomy.py add-type. 'essence' = soul/voice/relationship moments captured in the person's own words, not flattened to work.

summary.description: Detailed narrative — no character limit. Write as much detail as the event deserves.

decisions.description: Decisions made: the choice, alternatives considered, reasoning, and constraints.

learnings.description: Things genuinely learned — the setup, the surprise, the principle, the application.

corrections.description: Mistakes made: observable symptom, root cause, fix applied, prevention rule, recurrence flag.

skill_area.description: Domain of growth — user-defined, common values: architecture, frontend, backend, data, ops, design, leadership

complexity.description: Honest complexity assessment. routine = done this before. breakthrough = genuinely new territory.

autonomy.description: Who drove the decisions. guided = AI-led. collaborative = real back-and-forth. independent = user drove.

notes.description: What this session taught about development — specific, not generic.

behavioral.description: Opt-in behavioral observations. Only populated when behavioral_tracking is enabled in config.

drive_state.description: What mode the user is operating in — building (creating new), firefighting (reacting to problems), avoiding (deferring uncomfortable tasks), maintaining (operational upkeep), exploring (researching/learning), closing (finishing and delivering)

energy.description: Observable energy level — high (rapid decisions, enthusiasm), steady (focused and methodical), low (delayed responses, shorter messages), scattered (context-switching, tangents)

triggers.description: What prompted the current behavior — external pressure, intrinsic motivation, guilt, excitement, deadline, boredom, client feedback

avoidance_signals.description: Tasks mentioned but deferred, emails referenced but not sent, scope creep into new features instead of finishing current work

language_markers.description: Notable phrases that reveal mindset — momentum markers, guilt-driven phrasing, high-confidence commands, pivoting/distracted interjections

cognitive_load.description: How many threads the user is juggling — focused (1 project deep), moderate (2-3 projects), overloaded (4+ or rapid switching)

notes.description: Free-form behavioral observation — what a psychologist would note watching this session

professional_development.description: Observations against 9 professional developer benchmarks. Only populate fields relevant to this session.

lookup_comfort.description: Did the user look things up freely or work around knowledge gaps silently?

review_adoption.description: Did features go through show-before-build, or straight to implementation?

reading_before_writing.description: Did the session start with reading existing code, or jump to building?

context_switches.description: Number of project switches this session

build_vs_buy.description: Were existing tools/libraries checked before building from scratch?

commit_discipline.description: Small+frequent commits with good messages, or large batch commits?

testing_at_boundaries.description: Tested on target device/viewport, or only build-tested?

debt_awareness.description: Was technical debt taken intentionally with documentation, or accumulated accidentally?

imposter_signals.description: Language showing calibration ('I dont know this yet' = healthy) vs self-criticism ('I should know this' = imposter syndrome)

learning_story.description: Full journey narrative for Scribe-to-Scribe packet sharing. Captures attempts, thinking, and outcomes.

attempts.description: What was tried, in order, including failures.

thinking.description: The reasoning that led to the eventual solution.

transferable_lesson.description: What someone else can apply without repeating the full journey.
